D-001.threat: OT protocol flooding — attacker floods OT protocol stack causing denial of service
D-001.cause: OT protocol stack has no rate limiting — flooding causes processing overload
D-001.attack: Attacker floods the OT protocol interface with high-frequency frames starving legitimate traffic

D-002.threat: Embedded system flooding — attacker overwhelms embedded controller communication stack
D-002.cause: No rate limiting on embedded communication interface — all frames are processed regardless of volume
D-002.attack: Attacker floods the fieldbus with high-frequency frames exhausting the embedded system communication stack

D-003.threat: Safety system denial of service — attacker disrupts safety-critical communication
D-003.cause: Safety-critical communication has no redundant path and lacks DoS protection
D-003.attack: Attacker disrupts communication to the safety system causing it to fail safe or fail dangerous

D-004.threat: Cable disconnection causing loss of availability — no redundant path for field cable
D-004.cause: Data flow uses a single field cable with no redundant path
D-004.attack: Attacker cuts or disconnects the field cable, causing complete loss of the data flow

D-005.threat: Disruption of safety-critical data flow — safety function unavailable on demand
D-005.cause: Safety-critical data flow has no redundant path — disruption directly prevents the safety function from operating
D-005.attack: Attacker floods or physically disrupts the safety-critical data flow, preventing emergency stop commands from reaching their destination
